source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of 'Hypertext Transfer Protocol (HTTP)' (PDF 14): the same text in simple Roman Urdu with glossed hard words, a self-check and a recap.

blocks.text: HTTP ka matlab hai Hypertext Transfer Protocol. Yeh web pages transfer karne (bhejne) ke liye istemal hota hai. HTTP web browser aur web server (websites rakhne wala computer) ke darmiyan kaam karta hai. Is se users websites dekh sakte hain. HTTP data ko encrypt (khufia code mein) nahi karta; is liye secure (mehfooz) websites is ki jagah HTTPS istemal karti hain. HTTPS, HTTP ka secure version hai. Yeh web browser aur web server ke darmiyan jane wale data ko encryption se bachata hai. Yeh encryption SSL/TLS protocols deti hain, jo yaqeeni banati hain ke sensitive (hassas, chhupane wali) maloomat, jaise passwords, zaati details aur payment ka data, attackers (hamla karne wale) aasani se raaste mein intercept (beech mein pakar) na sakein.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Browser ke address bar mein "https://" aur taale (lock) ka nishan ho to website HTTPS istemal kar rahi hai. Password ya card number sirf aisi website par likhein.

blocks.prompt: Web pages dekhne ke liye kaun sa protocol use hota hai, aur secure websites is ke bajaye HTTPS kyun use karti hain?
blocks.explanation: HTTP. Yeh data encrypt nahi karta, is liye secure websites HTTPS use karti hain jo SSL/TLS se data encrypt karta hai taake passwords aur payment ka data churaya na ja sake.

items: HTTP: browser aur web server ke darmiyan web pages; encryption nahi. HTTPS: SSL/TLS se encrypted, mehfooz version.
